name: PA
desc: A 1990s shopping mall public address announcer: a calm, polite, slightly bored middle-aged American woman reading closing announcements into a microphone, even and unhurried, a little too calm. Clear recording.
text: Attention shoppers. The Halloway Galleria is now closed. Thank you for shopping with us. We are still waiting for one remaining shopper. Please make your way to the main entrance.
